<!-- The every-trail route: stats, map, legend, elevation profile and GPX, for
the Ultra and Bikes pages. Needs _common.qmd, and an ULTRA cell on the page:
({file, trails: "park trail", done: "run", gpxTitle, gpxFile}). Its names
(ultraMap, ultraProfile, ...) don't clash with the route picker's. -->

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
ultra = d3.json(ULTRA.file) // FileAttachment only takes a literal name
stats = ultra.stats

function kmRange([a, b]) {
  const [from, to] = [Math.round(a), Math.round(b)];
  return from === to ? `km ${from}` : `km ${from}–${to}`;
}

// "start, km 19–21, km 51, finish" for the Park Centre; just the km elsewhere.
function aidPasses(name, stops) {
  const kms = stops.map(kmRange);
  return name === "Park Centre" ? ["start", ...kms.slice(1, -1), "finish"].join(", ") : kms.join(", ");
}

// Aid station passes (km), the sure ones or the optional ones.
function aidKm(optional) {
  return Object.entries(stats.aid)
    .filter(([name]) => stats.aid_optional.includes(name) === optional)
    .flatMap(([, stops]) => stops.map(([a]) => a));
}

// Labels for the passes mid-run, at the top of the profile.
function aidLabels(optional) {
  return aidKm(optional).filter((km) => km > 0 && km < stats.km).map((km) => ({km}));
}

function onTheWay(kind) {
  return stats.on_the_way.filter(([, , kinds]) => kinds.includes(kind)).map(kmRange);
}
water = onTheWay("water")

html`<div class="route-card">
  <p class="route-stats">
    <strong>${stats.km} km</strong> ·
    <strong>↑ ${stats.gain_m} m ↓ ${stats.loss_m} m</strong> ·
    every trail (${stats.trail_km} of ${stats.park_trail_km} km of ${ULTRA.trails}) ·
    ${stats.repeat_km} km ${ULTRA.done} twice · ${stats.street_pct}% street
  </p>
  <p class="route-stats">
    <strong>Aid stations</strong>: ${Object.entries(stats.aid)
      .map(([name, stops]) => `${stats.aid_optional.includes(name) ? "optional, if there's a second car: " : ""}${name} (${aidPasses(name, stops)})`)
      .join("; ")} ·
    <strong>Toilets on the way</strong>: ${onTheWay("toilets").join(", ")} ·
    <strong>Water</strong>: the Park Centre${water.length ? `, and near ${water.join(", ")}` : " only"}
  </p>
  <p class="route-id">Short dead-end offshoots are optional: without them it's
    ${stats.km_without_offshoots} km (they add ${stats.offshoot_km} km, out and back).</p>
</div>`
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
ultraMapDiv = html`<div class="route-map ultra-map"></div>`
```

```{ojs}
</div>`
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false

// Toilets, water, or both: drawn by amenities.js, the same as on the route pages.
ICONS = amenity.icons()
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
//| output: false
ultraMap = {
  const m = new maplibregl.Map({
    container: ultraMapDiv,
    style: "https://tiles.openfreemap.org/styles/positron",
    center: START,
    zoom: 12.5,
    attributionControl: {customAttribution: "Trails © OpenStreetMap contributors (ODbL)"}
  });
  m.addControl(new maplibregl.NavigationControl(), "top-right");
  m.addControl(new maplibregl.FullscreenControl(), "top-right");
  await new Promise((resolve) => m.on("load", resolve));
  m.addSource("labels", {type: "geojson", data: labels});
  m.addSource("segments", {type: "geojson", data: ultra.segments});
  m.addSource("points", {type: "geojson", data: ultra.points});
  m.addSource("hover", {type: "geojson", data: EMPTY});
  const round = {"line-join": "round", "line-cap": "round"};
  const width = ["interpolate", ["linear"], ["zoom"], 12, 2.5, 16, 5];
  const kind = (k) => ["==", ["get", "class"], k];
  m.addLayer({id: "trails", type: "line", source: "labels", layout: round,
              filter: ["==", ["get", "kind"], "trail"],
              paint: {"line-color": "#6b8f71", "line-opacity": 0.6, "line-width": 1}});
  // Stretches run twice are drawn beside the first pass, so both show.
  m.addLayer({id: "repeat", type: "line", source: "segments", layout: round, filter: kind("repeat"),
              paint: {"line-color": "#eb6834", "line-width": width, "line-offset": 3}});
  m.addLayer({id: "first", type: "line", source: "segments", layout: round, filter: kind("first"),
              paint: {"line-color": "#2a78d6", "line-width": width}});
  m.addLayer({id: "optional", type: "line", source: "segments", filter: kind("optional"),
              paint: {"line-color": "#4a3aa7", "line-width": width, "line-dasharray": [1, 1]}});
  m.addLayer({id: "arrows", type: "symbol", source: "segments",
              layout: {"symbol-placement": "line", "symbol-spacing": 120, "text-field": "›",
                       "text-font": ["Noto Sans Bold"], "text-size": 18,
                       "text-keep-upright": false, "text-allow-overlap": true,
                       "text-ignore-placement": true},
              paint: {"text-color": "#0b0b0b"}});
  const halo = {"text-halo-color": "#fcfcfb", "text-halo-width": 1.5};
  const along = (size, font) => ({"symbol-placement": "line", "text-field": ["get", "name"],
    "text-font": [font], "text-size": size, "text-max-angle": 45, "symbol-spacing": 250});
  m.addLayer({id: "street-labels", type: "symbol", source: "labels", minzoom: 13,
              filter: ["==", ["get", "kind"], "street"], layout: along(10.5, "Noto Sans Regular"),
              paint: {"text-color": "#52514e", ...halo}});
  m.addLayer({id: "trail-labels", type: "symbol", source: "labels", minzoom: 13,
              filter: ["==", ["get", "kind"], "trail"], layout: along(11, "Noto Sans Italic"),
              paint: {"text-color": "#3d6b47", ...halo}});
  // km markers and toilets
  m.addLayer({id: "km", type: "circle", source: "points", filter: ["==", ["get", "kind"], "km"],
              paint: {"circle-radius": 11, "circle-color": "#fcfcfb",
                      "circle-stroke-color": "#0b0b0b", "circle-stroke-width": 2}});
  m.addLayer({id: "km-labels", type: "symbol", source: "points", filter: ["==", ["get", "kind"], "km"],
              layout: {"text-field": ["get", "label"], "text-font": ["Noto Sans Bold"],
                       "text-size": 11, "text-allow-overlap": true},
              paint: {"text-color": "#0b0b0b"}});
  // Toilets and water on the way (with the km of each pass, in the popup)
  amenity.addToMap(m, maplibregl, {
    type: "FeatureCollection",
    features: ultra.points.features.filter((f) => f.properties.kind in amenity.AMENITY)
  });
  m.addLayer({id: "hover", type: "circle", source: "hover",
              paint: {"circle-radius": 7, "circle-color": "#eb6834",
                      "circle-stroke-color": "#fcfcfb", "circle-stroke-width": 2}});
  for (const f of ultra.points.features.filter((f) => f.properties.kind === "aid")) {
    const main = f.properties.name === "Park Centre"; // also the start and finish
    new maplibregl.Marker({color: main ? "#0b0b0b" : "#898781"})
      .setLngLat(f.geometry.coordinates)
      .setPopup(new maplibregl.Popup().setText(
        `${main ? "Start, finish and aid station" : f.properties.optional
          ? "Optional aid station, if there's a second car" : "Aid station"}: ${f.properties.name}, ${f.properties.label}`))
      .addTo(m);
  }
  const bounds = new maplibregl.LngLatBounds();
  ultra.full.forEach((c) => bounds.extend(c));
  m.fitBounds(bounds, {padding: 30, duration: 0});
  invalidation.then(() => m.remove());
  return m;
}
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
ultraProfile = ultra.profile.map(([km, m, lon, lat]) => ({km, m, lon, lat}))

// Toilets and water on the way, as on the map (amenities.js).
ultraPassed = amenity.onProfile(stats.passes_by, ultraProfile)

// What's at this km, for the tooltip.
function whatsHere(km) {
  const near = (a, b = a) => a - 0.15 <= km && km <= b + 0.15;
  const what = Object.entries(stats.aid)
    .filter(([, stops]) => stops.some(([a, b]) => near(a, b)))
    .map(([name]) => `${stats.aid_optional.includes(name) ? "optional aid station" : "aid station"} (${name})`);
  what.push(...amenity.passedNear(stats.passes_by, km));
  return what.length ? ` · ${what.join(", ")}` : "";
}

viewof ultraHere = {
  const profile = ultraProfile;
  const low = Math.floor((d3.min(profile, (d) => d.m) - 5) / 10) * 10;
  return Plot.plot({
    width,
    height: 190,
    marginLeft: 44,
    marginTop: 26, // room for the AS labels
    style: {fontSize: "12px"},
    x: {label: "km →", domain: [0, stats.km]},
    y: {label: "↑ elevation (m)", domain: [low, d3.max(profile, (d) => d.m) + 20], grid: true},
    marks: [
      Plot.areaY(profile, {x: "km", y1: low, y2: "m", fill: "#2a78d6", fillOpacity: 0.12}),
      Plot.lineY(profile, {x: "km", y: "m", stroke: "#2a78d6", strokeWidth: 1.5}),
      // Aid station passes
      // Aid stations: the Park Centre bold ("AS"); the optional one grey and
      // dotted ("(AS)"), as it may not be there
      Plot.ruleX(aidKm(false), {stroke: "#0b0b0b", strokeWidth: 1.5, strokeDasharray: "5,3"}),
      Plot.ruleX(aidKm(true), {stroke: "#898781", strokeDasharray: "2,3"}),
      Plot.text(aidLabels(false), {x: "km", text: () => "AS", frameAnchor: "top", dy: -8,
                                   fontSize: 10, fontWeight: 700, fill: "#0b0b0b"}),
      Plot.text(aidLabels(true), {x: "km", text: () => "(AS)", frameAnchor: "top", dy: -8,
                                  fontSize: 10, fill: "#898781"}),
      ...amenity.profileMarks(Plot, ultraPassed),
      Plot.ruleX(profile, Plot.pointerX({x: "km", stroke: "#52514e"})),
      Plot.dot(profile, Plot.pointerX({x: "km", y: "m", fill: "#eb6834", r: 4})),
      Plot.tip(profile, Plot.pointerX({x: "km", y: "m",
        title: (d) => `${d.km.toFixed(1)} km · ${Math.round(d.m)} m${whatsHere(d.km)}`}))
    ]
  });
}
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false

ultraMap.getSource("hover").setData(
  ultraHere?.lon
    ? {type: "Feature", geometry: {type: "Point", coordinates: [ultraHere.lon, ultraHere.lat]}}
    : EMPTY
)
```

On the profile, **AS** marks the passes by the Park Centre aid station and a
grey **(AS)** the optional one at King Edward; the WC and W dots are the
toilets and water on the way.

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
function ultraGpx(name, coordinates) {
  const points = coordinates.map(([lon, lat]) => `<trkpt lat="${lat}" lon="${lon}"></trkpt>`);
  return `<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<gpx version="1.1" creator="psp-trails" xmlns="http://www.topografix.com/GPX/1/1">
  <trk>
    <name>${name}</name>
    <trkseg>
      ${points.join("\n      ")}
    </trkseg>
  </trk>
</gpx>`;
}

html`<div class="route-actions">
  ${DOM.download(
    () => new Blob([ultraGpx(`${ULTRA.gpxTitle} (${stats.km} km)`, ultra.full)],
                   {type: "application/gpx+xml"}),
    `${ULTRA.gpxFile}.gpx`,
    "Download GPX"
  )}
  ${DOM.download(
    () => new Blob([ultraGpx(`${ULTRA.gpxTitle}, no offshoots (${stats.km_without_offshoots} km)`, ultra.main)],
                   {type: "application/gpx+xml"}),
    `${ULTRA.gpxFile}-no-offshoots.gpx`,
    "GPX without offshoots"
  )}
</div>`
```
